hypothesis_source: User identity (A-share short-term swing, daily bars, 5-20 sessions, right-side breakout/pullback) plus the 2026-09-10 operating-system contract. Prior 40-day / month-end tables do not accept this identity. This round asks whether each default event stream has a cost-adjusted signal-day-equal-weight edge at the swing windows.
distinct_from_failed_representations: No new detector, no pool-internal ranking, no exit-variant, no graphic-semantic gate, no monthly factor. Recompute scheduled 5/10/20-day open-to-open labels on frozen filled trades only. Difference from 40-day gross close-path early_excess_returns: those are not net round-trips and are not the primary metric here.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31, including prior family-wide reads of the same years. 2023+ on the leader ledger is exposure only. Not a clean holdout.

leader_vcp.slice: Keep trades whose entry, scheduled exit and labels all fall on or before 2022-12-31. Do not re-detect.

windows.definition: Filled T+1 open entry already on the ledger; scheduled exit is the open of the 5th / 10th / 20th subsequent market session (signal-day + 6 / 11 / 21 market sessions). Missing stock bar, limit/suspension or calendar overrun does not roll to the next stock bar; that window is incomplete.

cost.formula: net = (exit_open / entry_price) * (1 - sell_cost_pct(exit_date)) / (1 + buy_cost_pct) - 1. entry_price is the frozen fill open. Do not treat entry-day open-to-close or gross early_close_returns as a net round-trip.

contrasts.vs_market: Same-window SH/SZ equal-weight observed-price open-to-open: entry-day oc, intervening cc, exit-day co. Geometric excess (1+stock)/(1+market)-1.
contrasts.vs_same_day_unselected: Only if a same-day unselected set exists in the frozen inputs. Event-stream ledgers that take every detector hit have no such set; mark unavailable and do not reconstruct a full-market non-hit book.
contrasts.aggregation: Primary: signal-day equal-weight (mean of daily means) of net excess. Appendix: pooled trade mean. Group by entry_signal_date.

early_death: Among trades with highs on the entry session and the next market session, share whose max high/entry_price-1 over those two bars is < 0.03.

pass_fail.keep_as_tradable_seed: Training 10-day and 20-day signal-day-equal-weight net excess vs market are not both negative, and the stream is already a leader-gated event rather than a wide detector.
pass_fail.demote_to_observation_pool: Point estimate of 10-day or 20-day date-EW net excess vs market is negative, or same-day selection (if available) ranks the wrong way. Stop using the detector as a default executable selector. Do not decorate.
pass_fail.stop_as_selector: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net excess vs market are both negative and the 5-day diagnostic is also negative, or every training year is negative. Neighborhood of the default event definition stays stopped.
pass_fail.not_claimed: No live qualification, no clean 2023-2026 OOS, no parameter search.

halt: If a named run directory is missing, trade count mismatches the cited decision, or referenced opens for a complete window cannot be read, write a gap list and publish no invented numbers. Do not re-run full-market pattern detection.
bar_source: kline_daily_enriched partitions already listed in each run's data-references.json; same directory the original trade-path analysis used. Rebuild daily SH/SZ oc/cc/co from those bars rather than treating frozen early_excess_returns as net.
outputs: family decisions under vcp / cup-handle / high-tight-flag / pullback
